scenes.text: Your days, beautifully. Tasks and meetings live on calm pastel cards, with two world clocks always at a glance.
Flip through your months, and see every day laid out by the hour.
Frosted glass widgets float right on your home screen.
It speaks Amharic, and follows the Ethiopian calendar, Pagume included.
Fasika, Meskel, Timket, and every fast, from Abiy Tsom to the Wednesday and Friday fasts, are built in.
And it stays in sync with Google, iCloud, and Outlook.
Glass Calendar. Your time, beautifully kept.
